items.title: The Bird's First Perception of the World
items.explanation: According to the text, the baby bird thought its first world was small, round, and light blue. It was made of a pale, blue shell and nestled by its mother.

items.title: The Bird's Second Perception of the World
items.explanation: After leaving the shell, the bird saw leaves and thought it had been very blind. It felt the world was warm and comfortable, made of straw, with its mother nearby.

items.title: The Bird's Final Perception of the World
items.explanation: At length, the bird flew beyond the tree and said the world is made of leaves. However, it also realized that it had been very blind because it could not see the leaves from its nest.

items.title: The Bird's Adult Perception of the World
items.explanation: When the bird became an adult, it flew away and said the world is made of leaves. It also realized that it had been very blind because it could not see the leaves from its nest.
